body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affected PR #935 merge `7245eca6d56ee71fd1f40631c72116167ac5037d`, head `05c5fc02b666fcc8b68360b02d62a01937a715da`.

**Executed finding:** the exact ordinary `findings/reproduce.py` accepts a CSV fixture in which `gb:CHL:ADM3:31580391B10529430884395` (`Castro`) has `source_shape_id` changed from `31580391B10529430884395` to `FABRICATED-NOT-A-SOURCE-ID`. Location IDs, counts, the `name_exact_match=True` flag and all original baseline/metadata bytes remain unchanged. It exits successfully and reports `exact_source_name_links: 214`, `paraguay_ine_2022_candidate_roster_matches: 47` and “identity/source/scope checks pass”, while independently restored source hashes are zero. This claims source-link check coverage despite never checking the candidate row’s source ID/name against either the available baseline metadata or restored source records. The committed rows do match retained baseline metadata; the defect is false-positive validation of a corrupted candidate.

**Reproduction and limits:** run the immutable ordinary script inside an isolated checkout with only `Path.open` of `findings/crosswalk.csv` substituted by an in-memory fixture containing that one change. No `--restore-sources`, network call or original-file edit is needed. The same candidate CSV, with its manifest output size/hash consistently recomputed, passes the shared byte validator as limited; that byte result is not semantic validation. The full restoration branch would reject the fabricated ID, but it downloads 171,783,952-byte Chile and 45,589,273-byte Paraguay originals into temporary files. Those unretained originals exceed the ordinary/decompressed evidence limit; I did not run that branch or bypass the limit. The no-restoration script’s current flags/counts are not equivalent to independently checking originals. The 55,137-byte INE original response is also unretained: nonempty derived fields cannot reverify its 47 mappings.

**Expected behavior and success criteria:**
- Create additive evidence/validation files only in the new owned directory, preserving every original #935 packet file, results and later #948 purpose/scale evidence. Do not edit core geography, shared hierarchy or originals.
- Resolve all 215 exact immutable baseline subjects (167 Chile, 47 Paraguay, one Asunción aggregate) and all 39 actual parents. Check each candidate row’s actual ID/name/parent, source-shape/member ID and type against what the retained baseline supports; duplicates, omissions and foreign/mixed rows fail even after consistent rehashing. Source-derived geometry fields and current statistical/legal identity remain observations unless original inputs are actually verified.
- Report separate counts/statuses for checked baseline relationships, author-recorded source observations, independently verified source relationships and unavailable restoration. Ordinary mode must not label 214 source joins as reverified without doing the relevant checks. INE candidate fields must likewise remain explicitly unverified without its exact source response. Never treat statistical identity as legal boundary evidence.
- Run valid data and meaningful negative controls for invented IDs, incorrect names/parents, duplicate/missing subjects and stale/consistently rehashed candidate results. Run twice deterministically, retain hashed outputs and bind numerical metrics to actual rows; obtain substantive distinct exact-head review through normal gates.
- Account for every changed file, including the new manifest’s change receipt while excluding its self-hash, under current premerge validation. The original legacy manifest has 14 receipts for 15 changed files and no numeric metric bindings; do not present its standalone limited byte check as full current premerge or numerical review.
- No oversized restoration bypass: first obtain a reviewed bounded restoration/partition route if original geometry is needed. Missing original/source/legal checks stay explicit; do not manufacture source data or a geographic approval.

Parent #445 is closed by later PR #948; its reservation must remain untouched. This is distinct from #932/#933 factual source/legal work and #930’s city engineering assessment. #1111 concerns a different original packet/verifier and an exact 263-subject crosswalk scope; #1101/#1107 likewise have different owners/packets. Expanding those contracts would conflate independent evidence vintages. New owned paths are disjoint, even where subjects legitimately overlap. Deduplicate this exact verifier/coverage defect before claiming. No implementation reservation, geography approval, import, deployment or original-issue closure is authorized by this audit.

Named pins bind actual complete files at immutable ancestor `7245eca6d56ee71fd1f40631c72116167ac5037d`; the later source register was expanded by #948, so preserve this original vintage rather than repinning it silently. The new manifest must bind the same names to its actual baseline.pin_files descriptors and resolve containing parts via the world index.
